quest.title: Their Childhood: A Certain Passage
quest.description: Verut and Lovi seem to be playing some game, but Aurele is nowhere to be seen...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Lovi, did you find something good?

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Nope, there's nothing here at all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: We're looking for treasure! Hehe... Would you like to join us?

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: Don't listen to Verut's bragging. We're just looking to fish up some components.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Well, the components are treasure... Huh? There should be some here...

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: Looks like we're not going to find anything here. Shall we go somewhere else?

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Sure! Let's go a little further up ahead.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Whoa, you're starting to sound like my brother...

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Well, let's just walk a little further. I'm quite sure the waters around here were full of components...

choices.text: You shouldn't go running around everywhere.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: He went to look for Mr. Delerue with some questions.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: As for us, we had to be good and stay good... and search for treasure.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Hehe, so... would you like to join us?

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: Don't listen to Verut's bragging. We're just looking to fish up some components.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Well, the components are treasure... Huh? There should be some here...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: There's just some rotten cardboard here... and no components.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: That's weird. I fished a few gears out of the water here just yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Found one! This gear is quite complete. There's even a whole bearing over here.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Nice, we can use these!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: These are... tattered clothes? Their colors have run completely...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Has someone fished around this area already? There are no components here at all...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Let me see... We can use this gear, and if we saw this bearing open...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking for this for?

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: I'm trying to make my own clockwork puppet. Actually, I've been secretly looking into knowledge related to that.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Once I figure it all out, I'm going to make a huge Clockwork Meka — now that'll stun Daddy!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: I've read lots of books in his room, and I've made some basic components according to the instructions therein.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: I'm pretty sure that mek's within reach so long as I keep working at it!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: But I can't study these things in the city, or he'll find out — and that would ruin the surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: That's how this place became Lovi's secret clockwork research base. As for me... Well, I'm her assistant.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Well, assistant, talk is cheap! Let's start our research. Today, we must make a moving mechanical arm!

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Aye aye, ma'am! Let our research begin!
